title: lean4-review-output/v2
description: Shared review-OUTPUT contract (Issue #115). Consumed by Codex via `codex exec --output-schema "$LEAN4_REFS/lean4-review-schema.json"` and produced by custom /lean4:review hooks. OpenAI Structured Outputs constrained: object root, additionalProperties:false on every object, every property in required, semantic optionals expressed as nullable types.

error.description: Non-null when the reviewer could not complete; suggestions is then empty.

file.description: File the finding applies to; null for a PR-level (metadata) finding with no file location.

line.description: 1-indexed line; null when there is no concrete location (e.g. metadata).

rule_id.description: Optional specific rule within a category, e.g. "vacuous-api" under category "api"; null when unset.

fix.description: Suggested code (internal hooks only). External Codex reviews set null.

by_severity.description: Count per severity; nonnegative integer, 0 (never null) when a severity has no findings. Property names are exactly the severity enum.

severity.description: advisory is the settled value for the vacuous-api rule; style is legacy-accepted.

category.description: Mathlib-review taxonomy vocabulary (#114) plus legacy-accepted values. Legacy values are accepted, not normalized.
